 The England Tour of Australia begins early Saturday, kicking off a five-match T20I series in Melbourne, Australia. 
 England and Australia kick off a five-match T20I series on Saturday morning at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. The match starts at 3:10 a.m. ET and 1:10 p.m. local time. Australia will have the slight edge being at home, but these are very evenly matched national teams. Both teams have 12 international wins and two no-results in T20Is. In 11 matches in Australia, the home club has a 7-3-1 record against England. The second T20I matchup is on Tuesday, Nov. 24, at the same time, in Carrara (Gold Coast). The third T20I will be held next Friday at The Gabba in Brisbane. The series will continue moving around Australia for the fourth T20I matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29 at the Sydney Cricket Ground in Sydney. Finally, the last and fifth T20I will close out the series on Wednesday, Dec. 2 at Manuka Oval in Canberra. All matches start at the same time, 3:10 a.m. ET time. The two last met in England in 2024 in T20 play, where it ended in a 1-1 draw. Who will prevail this time in this matchup between two elite countries?
